newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 100 bln lire of Italy 30-yr BTP.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 100 bln lire of Italy 30-yr BTP.

text.p: Specialist bond traders were allocated 100 billion lire worth of 30-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against bids for 339 billion lire worth and the Italian Treasury's offer of 100 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 2.040 trillion lire at the open auction for the November 1, 2026 paper, against one trillion lire worth of paper on offer.
The auction price was set at 89.20 from 93.70 at the previous sale on February 27 giving a gross yield of 8.39 percent against 7.94 percent.
